question: Our users cannot find anything in our knowledge base because the search is a SQL LIKE query. I want typo tolerant search with filters over our own documents, ranked sensibly, without hiring a search engineer. Node backend, a few hundred thousand documents. Which service would you use, and what else did you consider?
rationale: Typesense documents document collections, typo-tolerant search, filters and JavaScript integration. These support the knowledge-base brief. Capacity, relevance and hosted-cluster cost still need the actual corpus and query workload.
nextStep: Update and delete documents, repeat the same query set, and confirm the collection returns the expected current records.

sources.note: JavaScript client setup, collections, document indexing and search.
Typo-tolerant search integration and search UI.
Cloud pricing is separate from operating a local open-source instance.
